 "data": "@startuml
title API Execution Flow - Cypress API Integration

actor Tester
participant \"Test Lab\" as Lab
participant \"TestRunnerFactory\" as Factory
participant \"ApiTestRunnerService\" as Runner
participant \"ApiBuilderFactory\" as Builder
participant \"Cypress\" as Cypress
participant \"Target Site\" as API

Tester -> Lab : Execute Test Script
Lab -> Factory : Detect test_type

alt test_type = API
 Factory -> Runner : Instantiate API Runner
end

Runner -> Builder : Build endpoint + method
Builder --> Runner : Return endpoint configuration

Runner -> Cypress : cy.request(method,\nendpoint, params)
Cypress -> API : HTTP GET/PUT/POST Request

API --> Cypress : HTTP Response\n(Status + Body)
Cypress --> Runner : Response Object

alt Status >= 400
 Runner -> Lab : Mark Step Failed\nLog Error
else Status = 200
 Runner -> Runner : Validate response fields\n(JSON comparison)
 Runner -> Lab : Mark Step Passed
end

@enduml

 "format": "svg"
